7.4.3.5.3 Dem Low Proxy
As shown in figure 7.10, the Dem Low Proxy shall be able to invoke APIs of the BSW modules in the Host Software Cluster, without a partition change in the Application Software Clusters. This partition change is only needed, if the BSW module does not offer a satellite on this partition. The availability of the BSW modules on dedicated EcucPartitions is a property of the Host Software Cluster.
